[i]RP/lore in curent time :O[/i]

Even tough the situation about the virus continues, the nation of Nordiheim and its council are still been looking outwards to develop its economy, trade and increase its list of friends.
As such the nation have recently aproched the nation of BR Bob for the the purpose of trade in military and civilian capacity and general friendship.

[u]As a result of this the two nations have agreed to the following tings:[/u]
-A general agreement of open trade between both nations (and some tea for breakfast time :D )
-Nordiheim will sell the nation of BR Bob military vehicles, equipment and munitions for its ground forces.
-The nation of Nordiheim will commision the construction of a aircraft carrier for its navy.
-BR Bob will aid Nordiheim in developing its own aircraft carrier progrem for the future of the Nordiheimian navy.
-A mutual declaration of friendship and future co-operation.

Both nations created and put together this agreement of tea and crumpets with a wide selection of jams and preserves made from fruits and berries sourced from both nations.

[spoiler=[b]The Nordiheimian and BR Bob Military and Civilian Trade and Friendship Deal of 10th of August 2025[/b]][align=center][b][u]The Tea Time Deal[/u][/b][/align]

[align=center][b]Trade and Friendship deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Democratic Federal Commonwealth of Bob[/b][/align]
[align=center][i]====================================================[/i][/align]

[align=center][i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and BR Bob agree to adhere to the following sections and points:[/u][/i][/align]
[align=center][i][u]_T__________________________________E____________________________________A_[/u][/i][/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Civilian Section![/u][/i][/b][/align]
[u][b]1:[/b][/u] Both parties agree to open their civilian markets for free trade between each others nations intheir entierty, including Nordiheims steel industry.

[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] All trade are to be done in "good fait" and with fair prices based on world market prices on a quarterly basis.

[u][b]2.b:[/b][/u] If there should be a large change or upsett in the world economy the trade prices can be changed outside of the quarterly basis if both nations agree.

[b][u]3.a:[/u][/b] The Nordiheim agrees to select the nation of BR Bob as "First Choise" for the purchase of quality tea at competetive prices of the variants and types that they sell.

[u][b]3.b:[/b][/u] BR Bob agrees to provide Nordiheim with the ability to buy reasonable quanteties of tea to purchase that is at the minimum of "Fine Bobian Quality"

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Military Section: Immidiate![/u][/i][/b][/align]
[u][b]1:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to sell the military vehicles, equipment and modules writhen down in this section to BR Bob at standard prices and to be delivered at soonest posible date within reason.

[u][b]Tanks (a):[/b][/u] Iron Drake 2D(MTB) = 200 units, Iron Drake 2E(MBT) = 50 units, Sand Drake 3A(AT) = 200 units

[b][u]Tanks (b):[/u][/b] Iron Drake 3(MBT) = 30 units now pluss an additionl 270 units produced over a 9 month period, Iron Drake 4(MBT) = 10 units now pluss an additional 90 units produced over a 9 months period.

[b][u]Other Vehicles:[/u][/b] AC-4B AA2(AC-AA) = 50 units, Kangaroo MAMIV = 200 units, Karlson 85MPT 7-10 = 400 units + 100 units of trailers(10t), Karlson 95MPT 10-20 = 100 units

[b][u]AA systems:[/u][/b] Tyr-1 Automatic AA module = 200 units, AAAMS-2B Valkyrie = 200 units, AAAMS-3A Shield maiden = 100 units, AAHAML-41 Module = 50 units, AMHAML-34/37 Module = 30 units

[b][u]Mobile System that can work with the AA systems:[/u][/b] CBA-M T47 Radar Module = 25 units

[b][u]Munitions/Missiles:[/u][/b] Nordiheim agrees to sell BR Bob enough munitions for all vehicle weapons, systems and modules to be considered combat capable and effective for 3 months of average combat deployment at standard prices.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Military Section: Over Time![/u][/i][/b][/align]
[b][u]1:[/u][/b] Nordiheim agrees to send an expeditionary team of military instructors to aid in teaching the military personel of BR Bobs military how to use all new vehicles, weapons and systems at full effectiveness.

[b][u]2.a:[/u][/b] The nation of BR Bob are given permission to freely buy more military vehicles, equipment and modules over time as needed at standard prices.
[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] The nation of BR Bob agrees to give Nordiheim a reasonable time schedule to produce and deliver any additional military vehicles, equipment and modules.

[b][u]3:[/u][/b] The nation of Nordiheims general military market of sale and production of munitions of all types are to be open to the nation of BR Bob to buy from as long as it dosen't endanger the security of the nation of Nordiheim.

[b][u]4.a:[/u][/b] The nation of Nordiheim agrees to a binding contract when signing this trade agreement that they can not stop deliveries of munitions and parts to the nation of BR Bob for 6 months should diplomacy between the two nations fall apart.
[b][u]4.b:[/u][/b] The only exeption to this binding agreement is if the nation of BR Bob were to become a fully hostile entity towards Nordiheim trough declaration or declare war ageinst Nordiheim or a nation that is allready an ally of Nordiheim.

[b][u]5.a:[/u][/b] The nation of BR Bob agrees to build Nordiheim 1 aircraft carrier (Based on the QE-class of carriers) wich will be delivered in 7 years (Augaust 2032 Erene time)
[b][u]5.b:[/u][/b] The nation of BR Bob also agrees to aid the nation of Nordiheim in research and development to establishing its own aircraft carrier program.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[align=center][b][i][u]Friendship and co-operation.[/u][/i][/b][/align]
[b][u]1.a:[/u][/b] With the signing of The Tea Time Deal the nations of Nordiheim and BR Bob singals a mutual declaration of friendship!

[b][u]1.b:[/u][/b] In the interest of friendship and co-operation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and BR Bob be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Tea Time Deal' as long as both parties can arrive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

[b][u]1.c:[/u][/b] The nation of Nordiheim agrees to aid the nation of BR Bob in securing the maritime trade lanes that they guard from pirates and similar if they were to request so, as long as if doing so doesn't jeopardize the national security of Nordiheim.

[align=center]++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++[/align]

[align=center][i]Signatory parties[/i][/align]

[align=center] [color=white]+++++++++++[/color] [u][i]The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u]  [color=white]+++++++the two nations great signatories++[/color]  [u][i]His Majesty King Bob of The Democratic Federal Commonwealth of Bob[/i][/u][/align][/spoiler]

"The Tea Time Deal" as it have been named was signed in the BR Bobs capitol city of Bob City by his majesty King Bob and the nations PM and diplomatic core and a diplomatic team from Nordiheim containing the council ministers that represent the regions that makes up the nation of Nordiheim under great fanfare and publicity.

The nation of Nordiheim look forward for this to mark a long and prosperous friendship between the two nations.

[nation]BR Bob[/nation]
[nation]Shahzada[/nation] rp
